LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON-FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read non-fiction materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise adjectives from a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct simple sentences using the adjectives formed,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the value of proper use of adjectives.  Search for online tutorials on adjectives and examples of adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. Control light intensity for learners who are sensitive to light while using digital devices.  Listen to a poem or passage from the teacher and pick out adjectives formed from nouns and verbs. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate adapted digital devices to perform this task.  Read a given passage and identify adjectives formed from nouns and verbs,  Form adjectives using nouns and verbs  Work with peers to construct simple sentences using the adjectives formed, 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non-Fiction materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy is strengthened as the learner reads a variety of non-fiction materials to inculcate a reading culture.

 Learning to learn is instilled as the learner searches for digital and print non-fiction materials using electronic gadgets.

Values:
Responsibility is honed as the learner makes informed choices by recommending to peers suitable non-fiction materials to read.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life skills, especially self-awareness, is developed as the learner makes own choice of non-fiction materials to interact with.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates extensive reading as a skill which is required in Kiswahili.
